fields.name: scope
fields.value: The project consists of replacing approximately 4,850 linear feet of existing 6-inch cast iron water main on Elm Street and Oak Avenue with 12-inch and 8-inch ductile iron water main. Work also includes new gate valves, fire hydrants, water services, temporary water, trench pavement, and final paving. Bid alternates include replacing 420 linear feet of 2-inch galvanized main on Birch Lane with 8-inch ductile iron and adding two hydrant assemblies.

example_answers.question: What testing is required for the new water main?

answer.text: Each section of the new water main must undergo pressure testing at 150 psi for two hours, with leakage not exceeding the allowable amount under AWWA C600. Additionally, two consecutive sets of bacteriological samples taken 24 hours apart must pass before the main is placed into service.

citations.quote: Each section of new main shall be pressure tested at 150 psi for two (2) hours.
Leakage shall not exceed the allowable amount in AWWA C600.
Two consecutive sets of bacteriological samples taken 24 hours apart must pass before the main is placed in service.
